observedHeaders: Energy Star
Available
Mixing of Heat sink is not allowed.
Supports only PC5-4800B Memory
BTO Memories are not allowed in CTO Base Model.
Mixing of different Rank memory is allowed only if max Qty is selected per processor (i.e. For 1Processor it is 16 and for 2 Processor it is 32).
96GB Memory cannot be mixed with any other Memory.
Mixing of 3DS and Non 3DS not allowed
Private Product is not valid for current customer account
EDSFF Bundle is supported with 12EDSFF CTO Server Only
Mixing of SR series and MR series Tri Mode controllers not allowed
Gen5 Re timer card is supported with 12EDSFF CTO Server Only.
Max quantity of product limited by space available.
This Cable is supported with 8LFF CTO Server and 12LFF CTO Server Only.
For 8SFF CTO Server, It can be selected only if NVMe bundle is selected.
Mid Tray can be selected with 205W or below Processors only.
12EDSFF Drive Cage / Drives can be selected with 12EDSFF CTO Server only.
This Drive cage can be selected with 8LFF CTO Server and 12LFF CTO Server Only.
This Drive cage can be selected with 8LFF CTO Server Only.
There are no "HPE Recommended products" available. Please use the toggle to show potential alternatives.
BTO products are not allowed in CTO Base Model.
This Cable is supported with 8LFF CTO Server Only.
If this Primary Riser is selected then default Primary riser is replaced with this Riser. The “PCIe Card Capacity Limits” must account for this limitation...
Only get enabled with Tertiary Riser [ P48826-B21 ]
If OCP2 x16 Enable Kit is selected then CPU2 / OCP2 x8 Enable Kit OR CPU1 / OCP2 x8 Enable Kit cannot be selected and Vice-versa.
HPE DL380 Gen11 NS204i-u FIO Kit can be selected only if HPE NS204i-u Boot Dev is selected.
Mixing of different Power supply SKU is not allowed.
HPE 1600W -48VDC Pwr Cbl Lug Kit(P36877-B21) Supported only with HPE 1600W FS -48VDC Ht Plg PS Kit (P17023-B21).
Not Supported ProStack Server Software
